primary_source_review.title: A Nearly Quartic Separation Between Randomized and Quantum Query Complexity
observations: The dummy input has one independent uniform zero in every column, independent address strings, and fixed blank cell bits.
The further uniform column I is independent of the entire dummy input.
Z counts columns with a discovered zero; the display includes both equality with E Z/m and the coefficient-four inequality.
The isolated discovery argument does not use promise support or hardness of P; the formal theorem safely generalizes the address distribution.
